question: 按分支统计 2013 年佣金率，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT dim_broker.Branch AS Branch, SUM(fact_trades.Commission) / SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) AS commission_rate FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker AS dim_broker ON fact_trades.SK_BrokerID = dim_broker.SK_BrokerID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2013 GROUP BY dim_broker.Branch ORDER BY commission_rate DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 佣金率 = 佣金合计 / 成交金额，无单位比率（口径以 YAML 表达式为准，派生指标锚定）
派生指标（比率）按分支分组 + TopN 排序组合
